sources.label: Morphe patches for Bejeweled Classic
sources.author: 6jarjar6
patch_list: Removes ads. Rewarded ads still grant their reward without playing.
Null-guards the GluAnalytics callback references (fixes latent NPEs).
Redirects the GET STARS! cross-promo button to the GitHub repo (instead of promoting EA’s game).
Removes android.permission.INTERNET, disabling the network entirely (fail-closed). All telemetry and ads are structurally severed.
Stops Nimble/Synergy, Firebase, GLUAnalytics (incl. privacy flags), Facebook/Unity, popcap, and IronSource mediation telemetry.
